metadata.title: fix: type mismatches and missing dependency checks in plugins
metadata.author: araujof

description:
## Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                                

Fixes #2103 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
- Fix metadata type mismatch in ToolsTelemetryExporterPlugin and VaultPlugin by using defensive attribute access that handles both ORM objects and dictionaries                                                        
- Fix ALTKJsonProcessor to gracefully handle missing ALTK dependency with conditional imports                                                                                                                          
- Add shared get_attr utility function to plugin framework for consistent defensive attribute access                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
##  Changes                                                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
- mcpgateway/plugins/framework/utils.py: Add get_attr() utility function                                                                                                                                               
- plugins/tools_telemetry_exporter/telemetry_exporter.py: Use shared get_attr for metadata access                                                                                                                      
- plugins/vault/vault_plugin.py: Use shared get_attr for gateway metadata access                                                                                                                                       
- plugins/altk_json_processor/json_processor.py: Wrap ALTK imports in try/except, skip processing when unavailable                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
## Tests                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
- Run pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/plugins/plugins/test_init_hooks_plugins.py -v  (#2102)
